package.name: gaceta
package.summary: A personal newspaper edited for one reader: stories, not articles; sources on every claim.

skill.name: gaceta
skill.description: Find what changed in stories from the reader's feeds.
skill.codex_description: Find what changed in stories from the reader's feeds. Read-only lookup over a public-only gaceta edition export: stories with their sources, and a what-changed-since-your-baseline brief. Do not use for summarizing a single article with no reader export; never runs owner/write commands.
skill.author: Gaceta News (gaceta-news)

codex_plugin.name: gaceta
codex_plugin.description: Read-only lookup of a gaceta reader's public edition export: stories with their sources, and a what-changed-since-your-baseline brief. Skills only: no MCP server, no hooks, no network.

links.desk_status: bilingual demo desk from the desk workstream; ships as a wheel asset — published URL pinned at release

tested_with.scope_note: Packaging and offline demo smoke only. Not discovery, not configured usage, not reader retention — those are separate (P5) evidence and are not claimed here.
